Sturdy_Digging_Forelimbs.description: Equipped with powerful and robust forelimbs, these canine terriers can effortlessly dig through the earth, creating tunnels at an astounding rate, though their agility is slightly diminished by the bulk of their digging muscles.

Webbed_Aquatic_Paddling_Paws.description: The Webbed_Aquatic_Paddling_Paws are large, muscular appendages that resemble the powerful limbs of a Newfoundland dog, yet are adapted for both land and water with extensive webbing between the toes, granting unparalleled speed in both swimming and walking, and enabling the use of the Swim_Dash skill.

Elongated_Coursing_Stilts.description: These slender, elongated stilts are a marvel of canine evolution, sprouting from the shoulder blades of swift greyhounds, enhancing their natural grace and dash with an added burst of speed and agility, allowing them to traverse the battlefield with relentless pursuit and endurance.

Massive_Bone_Crushing_Paws.description: Enormous, gnarled paws tipped with wickedly curved claws and dense bone structure, these canine appendages are both a weapon and a burden, granting immense strength in crushing blows and debilitating strikes, yet hampering agility with their sheer weight and size.

Cybernetic_Alloy_Striking_Forelegs.description: The Cybernetic_Alloy_Striking_Forelegs are a pair of formidable, metallic-enhanced forelimbs that bulge with mechanical sinews and razor-sharp claws, blending the ferocity of a predator with the unyielding strength of advanced alloys, allowing their wielder to tear through armor and flesh with equal ease and unleash devastating strikes at enhanced speeds.

Skeletal_Undead_Crawling_Claws.description: Bony claws, reminiscent of a canine's skeletal paws, scrabble across stone and wood alike with eerie dexterity, their sharp edges capable of tearing through flesh and grating against surfaces, leaving a trail of fear in their wake.

Retractable_Feline_Like_Claws.description: Bristling with razor-sharp, retractable claws that extend from sinewy, fox-like limbs, this entity component enhances agility and dexterity, granting the user the ability to scale sheer surfaces and grapple with unparalleled precision and ferocity.

Flexible_Arboreal_Scrambling_Arms.description: Equipped with a pair of prehensile, dexterous limbs that resemble the powerful forelegs of a dhole, these arms are not only adept at swift and silent movement on the ground but also enable their wielder to scale the tallest trees with the grace and agility of a spider, their fingers tipping with sharp, curved claws that grip onto bark and branch with effortless ease.

Frost_Covered_Arctic_Paws.description: Enveloped in a perpetual frost, these massive arctic paws belong to a powerful canine, granting their bearer a significant boost in constitution and strength, alongside an innate resistance to the biting cold of the frozen north.

Symbiotic_Spore_Emitting_Claws.description: The Symbiotic_Spore_Emitting_Claws are twisted, fungal-infused appendages that resemble gnarled canine paws, capable of emitting a toxic poison cloud and causing bleeding wounds, granting the wielder enhanced strength and resistance to poison.
